create_VizSeqDataSources: create VizSeqDataSources from a list of text file paths to load multiple aligned data sources
create_VizSeqDataSource: create a VizSeqDataSource from a single text file path or list of strings
create_VizSeqZipFileSource: create a VizSeqZipFileSource from a .zip file containing a metadata txt and media files
create_VizSeqTextFileSource: create a VizSeqTextFileSource from a single text file path to load lines as data
create_VizSeqListSource: create a VizSeqListSource from a list of strings as in-memory data source
